business_problem: KeyBank had experienced ServiceNow users but lacked the CMDB context, automation, and visibility needed to connect platform work with measurable business and risk outcomes.
solution_summary: KeyBank had experienced ServiceNow users but lacked the CMDB context, automation, and visibility needed to connect platform work with measurable business and risk outcomes. KeyBank implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, and CMDB. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; CMDB stores service and asset context. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, and uses context from CMDB before ServiceNow AI Platform and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running AI governance and compliance operations on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: CMDB
solution_components.role: Maintains service and asset context that automation and support teams rely on.
